points.description: Names one valid factor influencing chatter, from the model answer: depth of cut, hardness of the workpiece, or width of cut (clear synonyms accepted).
Names a second, different valid factor influencing chatter, from the model answer: depth of cut, hardness of the workpiece, or width of cut (clear synonyms accepted).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for two different correct factors from: depth of cut, hardness of workpiece, width of cut, in any clear wording. Give 1 mark if only one factor is correct, or if one is vague (e.g. "cutting conditions" without saying which). Give 0 for wrong or unrelated factors; repeats of the same factor count once.
